_comment: Commit this at .claude/settings.json in the target repo. A plugin cannot ship permissions; this is the second artifact a fully-harnessed repo needs. The deny list stops an agent reading secrets at all; the sandbox block makes that OS-enforced and prompt-free. excludedCommands and allowedDomains are per-repo. The two WebFetch(domain:...) allow rules also pre-allow sandboxed curl/git egress to GitHub. Rationale: docs/TARGET-REPO-SETUP.md in somnio-engineering-ai. env.GSTACK_SKIP_ASIDE=1 keeps gstack off the Aside real-browser driver and its third-party research agent until ADR-0009 is accepted; set it to "0" per repo only after that.
_comment_allow: Only rules that are true of EVERY repository live in permissions.allow. The target's own verification commands are read from its package.json scripts map and its Makefile by skills/harness-init/scripts/detect_toolchain.py and merged in as a fragment (template, then network, then commands, then the repo's own settings) -- they are never templated. Seven pnpm script rules used to sit in that list, lifted from one backend monorepo; five of them named nothing that existed in the next repo the template touched (acme-core, PR #403), and two were near-misses of the real names. A per-repo fact does not belong in a file every repo shares.
